about: Recording R0.7 20261021-1212 'rack2' (iPhone 16 Pro Max, low side, home 7 ft, 9-ball, 373.8 s). It holds TWO complete racks: rack 2A (0-167 s) and rack 2B (re-racked 168-196 s, break 212.4 s). Checked by eye by Claude from the video (0.5 fps overview; 1-3 fps around every shot; 3 fps at both breaks). Times are seconds from the start of the recording, 'at' = cue strike, about +/-0.5 s. First ball was judged at 1-3 fps only; null = not judged. Not reviewed by the player. Reconciled 2026-10-21 with Nackers' firsthand account (see RECONCILIATION.md): one pocket corrected (8 in rack 2A: P1, not P6). (rack2B)
